tool.name: Mantid Total Scattering
tool.description: Reduces simulated or measured NeXus runs to S(Q) and G(r)

configfiles.configfile:
{ "facility": "$experiment.facility", "instrument": "$experiment.instrument", "title": "$experiment.title",
"sample_files": [#for $i, $f in enumerate($data.sample_files)#{"path": "$f", "name": "$f.element_identifier"}#if $i + 1 < len($data.sample_files)#,#end if##end for#], "normalization_files": [#for $i, $f in enumerate($data.normalization_files)#{"path": "$f", "name": "$f.element_identifier"}#if $i + 1 < len($data.normalization_files)#,#end if##end for#], "calibration_file": #if $data.calibration_file# "$data.calibration_file" #else# null #end if#, "grouping_file": #if $data.grouping_file# "$data.grouping_file" #else# null #end if#,
"sample": { "material": "$sample.material", "mass_density": $sample.mass_density, "packing_fraction": $sample.packing_fraction, "geometry": { "shape": "$sample.geometry.shape", #if $sample.geometry.shape == "Cylinder" "radius": $sample.geometry.radius, #else "inner_radius": $sample.geometry.inner_radius, "outer_radius": $sample.geometry.outer_radius, #end if "height": $sample.geometry.height }, "absorption_correction": "$sample.absorption_correction", "multiple_scattering_correction": "$sample.multiple_scattering_correction", "inelastic_correction": { "type": "$sample.inelastic.inelastic_correction", #if $sample.inelastic.inelastic_correction == "Placzek" "order": "$sample.inelastic.order", "self": #if $sample.inelastic.self_scattering#true#else#false#end if#, "interference": #if $sample.inelastic.interference#true#else#false#end if#, "fit_spectrum_with": "$sample.inelastic.fit_spectrum_with", "lambda_binning_for_fit": "$sample.inelastic.lambda_binning_for_fit", "lambda_binning_for_calc": "$sample.inelastic.lambda_binning_for_calc" #else "order": null #end if } },
"normalization": { "material": "$normalization.material", "mass_density": $normalization.mass_density, "packing_fraction": $normalization.packing_fraction, "geometry": { "shape": "Cylinder", "radius": $normalization.radius, "height": $normalization.height }, "absorption_correction": "$normalization.absorption_correction", "multiple_scattering_correction": "$normalization.multiple_scattering_correction" },
"align_and_focus": { "tmin": $align_and_focus.tmin, "tmax": $align_and_focus.tmax, "extra_args": "$align_and_focus.extra_args" },
"merging": { "q_min": $merging.q_min, "q_delta": $merging.q_delta, "q_max": $merging.q_max, "high_q_linear_fit_range": $merging.high_q_linear_fit_range, "self_scattering_levels": [#for $i, $lvl in enumerate($merging.self_scattering_levels)#{"bank": $lvl.bank, "min": $lvl.level_min, "max": $lvl.level_max}#if $i + 1 < len($merging.self_scattering_levels)#,#end if##end for#] },
"advanced": { "beam_height": #if str($advanced.beam_height)# $advanced.beam_height #else# null #end if#, "push_positive_level": $advanced.push_positive_level, "debug_mode": #if $advanced.debug_mode#true#else#false#end if#, "processing_q_step": #if str($advanced.processing_q_step)# $advanced.processing_q_step #else# null #end if#, "config_overrides": #if $advanced.config_overrides# "$advanced.config_overrides" #else# null #end if# } }

param.name: sample_files
param.label: Sample NeXus file(s)
param.help: Required. The output_nexus datasets from Sample Simulator (Diffraction), or measured runs.

param.name: sample_background_files
param.label: Sample background (container) NeXus file(s)
param.help: Optional. If left empty, a zero-signal background is generated so no container is subtracted.

param.name: sample_background_background_files
param.label: Sample background background (empty instrument) NeXus file(s)
param.help: Optional. Only meaningful when a sample background is also given.

param.name: calibration_file
param.label: Calibration file
param.help: Optional. Defaults to the NOMAD calibration shipped in the tool image.

param.name: grouping_file
param.label: Initial detector grouping file
param.help: Optional. Applied during align-and-focus to keep memory use bounded. Defaults to the 16x8 NOMAD grouping shipped in the tool image.

param.name: material
param.label: Material (chemical formula)
param.help: Mantid chemical formula, e.g. 'Si', 'Ba Ti O3', 'Ce0.85 Y0.15 O2'.

param.name: multiple_scattering_correction
param.label: Multiple scattering correction
param.help: Must be compatible with the absorption correction; the reduction rejects invalid pairs.

param.name: inelastic_correction
param.label: Inelastic correction
param.help: Placzek needs beam monitors from the raw run on the analysis cluster and does not work with file-based input.

param.name: extra_args
param.label: Additional AlignAndFocusArgs (JSON object)
param.help: Escape hatch, merged over TMin/TMax. Example: {"ResampleX": -6000}

param.name: beam_height
param.label: Beam height (cm)
param.help: Only used by the FullPaalmanPings absorption correction.

param.name: processing_q_step
param.label: Processing Q step (1/Angstrom)
param.help: Q binning used while focussing, before the final merge. Left empty it is 0.001, or the merging Q step when an absorption correction is on - an absorption correction rebins every pixel individually, and a fine step over a 100k pixel instrument will exhaust memory.

param.name: config_overrides
param.label: MantidTotalScattering config overrides (JSON)
param.help: Escape hatch. Deep-merged over the generated input JSON.

has_text.text: Placzek inelastic correction reads beam monitors

tool.help:
**What it does**
Runs `MantidTotalScattering <https://github.com/neutrons/mantid_total_scattering>`_ on NeXus files from your history and produces the normalized structure factor S(Q) together with GSAS and Topas exports.
**Inputs**
The sample and normalization (vanadium) files are required; the three background inputs are optional. Each accepts several files, which the reduction sums. The files can come straight from **Sample Simulator (Diffraction)** or be measured runs saved as NeXus.
If you do not supply a sample background, the tool generates a zero-signal background so that the container subtraction the reduction always performs leaves your data unchanged.
Leaving the calibration and grouping inputs empty uses the NOMAD calibration and 16x8 grouping shipped inside the tool image, so a run needs no more than a sample file and a normalization file.
**Outputs**
* **S(Q)** - the reduction's ``SofQ`` NeXus file * **GSAS** - the ``.gsa`` export * **MTS input JSON** - the exact configuration used, so any run can be reproduced with ``mantidtotalscattering input.json`` * **console output** and a collection of the per-bank Topas ``.xye`` files
**Limitations**
The Placzek inelastic correction reads beam monitors from the raw run through the analysis cluster's catalogue and therefore cannot run on file-based input.
Sums over banks (``SumBanks``) are not exposed because the current reduction ignores that key.
